 * Description: Registers the wpbp/count-words ability using the WordPress Abilities API.

if ( ! defined( 'ABSPATH' ) ) {

/**

function wpbp_register_content_ability_category() {

	}

		)
	);
}
add_action( 'wp_abilities_api_categories_init', 'wpbp_register_content_ability_category' );

/**
 * Register the 'wpbp/count-words' ability.
 */
function wpbp_register_count_words_ability() {
	if ( ! function_exists( 'wp_register_ability' ) ) {
		return;
	}

	wp_register_ability(
		'wpbp/count-words',
		array(
			'label'               => __( 'Count Words', 'wpbp' ),
			'description'         => __( 'Counts the number of words in the supplied text.', 'wpbp' ),
			'category'            => 'wpbp-content',
			'input_schema'        => array(
				'type'                 => 'object',
				'properties'           => array(
					'text' => array(
						'type'        => 'string',
						'description' => __( 'The text whose words should be counted.', 'wpbp' ),
					),
				),
				'required'             => array( 'text' ),
				'additionalProperties' => false,
			),
			'output_schema'       => array(
				'type'        => 'integer',
				'description' => __( 'The number of words in the supplied text.', 'wpbp' ),
				'minimum'     => 0,
			),
			'execute_callback'    => 'wpbp_count_words_execute',
			'permission_callback' => '__return_true',
			'meta'                => array(
				'show_in_rest' => true,
				'annotations'  => array(
					'readonly'    => true,
					'destructive' => false,
					'idempotent'  => true,
				),
			),
		)
	);
}
add_action( 'wp_abilities_api_init', 'wpbp_register_count_words_ability' );

/**
 * Execute callback for the 'wpbp/count-words' ability.
 *
 * @param array $input Ability input containing a 'text' string.
 * @return int Number of words in the text.
 */
function wpbp_count_words_execute( $input ) {
	$text = '';

	if ( is_array( $input ) && isset( $input['text'] ) && is_string( $input['text'] ) ) {
		$text = $input['text'];
	}

	$text = wp_strip_all_tags( $text );
	$text = html_entity_decode( $text, ENT_QUOTES, get_bloginfo( 'charset' ) );
	$text = trim( $text );

	if ( '' === $text ) {
		return 0;
	}

	$words = preg_split( '/[\s\p{Z}]+/u', $text, -1, PREG_SPLIT_NO_EMPTY );

	if ( false === $words ) {
		// Fallback for invalid UTF-8 input.
		$words = preg_split( '/\s+/', $text, -1, PREG_SPLIT_NO_EMPTY );
	}

	return is_array( $words ) ? (int) count( $words ) : 0;
}

<?php
/**
 * Execute the named ability with no input and report the outcome.
 *
 * @param string $ability_name The registered ability name.
 * @return string The WP_Error code on failure, or 'ok' on success.
 */
function wpbp_abilities_api_005( string $ability_name ): string {
	if ( ! function_exists( 'wp_get_ability' ) ) {
		return 'abilities_api_unavailable';
	}

	$ability = wp_get_ability( $ability_name );

	if ( ! $ability instanceof WP_Ability ) {
		return 'ability_not_found';
	}

	$result = $ability->execute();

	if ( is_wp_error( $result ) ) {
		$code = $result->get_error_code();
		return ( '' === $code || null === $code ) ? 'unknown_error' : (string) $code;
	}

	return 'ok';
}

<?php
/**
 * Returns the sorted list of registered ability names belonging to the supplied category slug.
 *
 * @param string $category The category slug to filter by.
 * @return string[] Sorted list of ability names.
 */
function wpbp_abilities_api_011( string $category ): array {
	if ( ! function_exists( 'wp_get_abilities' ) ) {
		return array();
	}

	$abilities = wp_get_abilities();

	if ( empty( $abilities ) || ! is_array( $abilities ) ) {
		return array();
	}

	$names = array();

	foreach ( $abilities as $key => $ability ) {
		if ( ! is_object( $ability ) ) {
			continue;
		}

		$ability_category = null;

		if ( method_exists( $ability, 'get_category' ) ) {
			$ability_category = $ability->get_category();
		}

		if ( is_object( $ability_category ) ) {
			if ( method_exists( $ability_category, 'get_slug' ) ) {
				$ability_category = $ability_category->get_slug();
			} else {
				continue;
			}
		}

		if ( ! is_string( $ability_category ) || $ability_category !== $category ) {
			continue;
		}

		$name = null;

		if ( method_exists( $ability, 'get_name' ) ) {
			$name = $ability->get_name();
		} elseif ( is_string( $key ) ) {
			$name = $key;
		}

		if ( is_string( $name ) && '' !== $name ) {
			$names[] = $name;
		}
	}

	$names = array_values( array_unique( $names ) );
	sort( $names, SORT_STRING );

	return $names;
}

/**
 * Safely execute a registered ability via the Abilities API.
 *
 * @param string $ability_name Registered ability name.
 * @param mixed  $input        Input to pass to the ability.
 * @return array
 */
function wpbp_abilities_api_014( string $ability_name, $input ): array {
	if ( ! function_exists( 'wp_get_ability' ) ) {
		return array(
			'ok'   => false,
			'code' => 'abilities_api_unavailable',
		);
	}

	$ability = wp_get_ability( $ability_name );

	if ( null === $ability || ! is_object( $ability ) || ! method_exists( $ability, 'execute' ) ) {
		return array(
			'ok'   => false,
			'code' => 'ability_not_found',
		);
	}

	try {
		$result = $ability->execute( $input );
	} catch ( \Throwable $e ) {
		return array(
			'ok'   => false,
			'code' => 'ability_execution_exception',
		);
	}

	if ( is_wp_error( $result ) ) {
		$code = $result->get_error_code();

		return array(
			'ok'   => false,
			'code' => ( '' === $code || null === $code ) ? 'ability_execution_failed' : $code,
		);
	}

	return array(
		'ok'    => true,
		'value' => $result,
	);
}

/**
 * Temporarily disables WordPress AI support, reads the disabled state,
 * and restores normal support behavior before returning.
 *
 * @return bool The AI support state while the temporary disable filter was active.
 */
function wpbp_ai_client_001(): bool {
	if ( ! function_exists( 'wp_supports_ai' ) ) {
		return false;
	}

	$force_disable = static function () {
		return false;
	};

	add_filter( 'wp_supports_ai', $force_disable, PHP_INT_MAX );

	try {
		$supported = (bool) wp_supports_ai();
	} finally {
		remove_filter( 'wp_supports_ai', $force_disable, PHP_INT_MAX );
	}

	return $supported;
}

<?php
/**
 * Prevents a single AI text generation attempt and returns the resulting WP_Error code.
 *
 * @return string The WP_Error code produced by the prevented generation, or an empty string if none.
 */
function wpbp_ai_client_003(): string {
	if ( ! function_exists( 'wp_ai_client_prompt' ) ) {
		return '';
	}

	$prevent_callback = static function () {
		return true;
	};

	add_filter( 'wp_ai_client_prevent_prompt', $prevent_callback );

	try {
		$result = wp_ai_client_prompt( 'Write a short greeting.' )->generate_text();
	} catch ( \Throwable $e ) {
		remove_filter( 'wp_ai_client_prevent_prompt', $prevent_callback );
		return '';
	}

	remove_filter( 'wp_ai_client_prevent_prompt', $prevent_callback );

	if ( is_wp_error( $result ) ) {
		return (string) $result->get_error_code();
	}

	return '';
}

<?php
/**
 * Returns the AI Client function-call name for an ability name, and the
 * ability name obtained by converting that function name back.
 *
 * @param string $ability_name The ability name (e.g. "my-plugin/do-something").
 * @return array{function_name: string, ability_name: string}
 */
function wpbp_ai_client_004( string $ability_name ): array {
	if ( ! class_exists( 'WP_AI_Client_Ability_Function_Resolver' ) ) {
		return array(
			'function_name' => '',
			'ability_name'  => '',
		);
	}

	$to_function = array( 'WP_AI_Client_Ability_Function_Resolver', 'ability_name_to_function_name' );
	$to_ability  = array( 'WP_AI_Client_Ability_Function_Resolver', 'function_name_to_ability_name' );

	$method = new ReflectionMethod( 'WP_AI_Client_Ability_Function_Resolver', 'ability_name_to_function_name' );

	if ( ! $method->isStatic() ) {
		$resolver    = new WP_AI_Client_Ability_Function_Resolver();
		$to_function = array( $resolver, 'ability_name_to_function_name' );
		$to_ability  = array( $resolver, 'function_name_to_ability_name' );
	}

	$function_name        = (string) call_user_func( $to_function, $ability_name );
	$round_tripped_name   = (string) call_user_func( $to_ability, $function_name );

	return array(
		'function_name' => $function_name,
		'ability_name'  => $round_tripped_name,
	);
}

<?php
/**
 * Set the default AI client request timeout for all subsequently created prompt builders.
 *
 * @param float $seconds Timeout in seconds.
 * @return void
 */
function wpbp_ai_client_006( float $seconds ): void {
	static $callback = null;

	// Remove any previously registered callback so repeated calls don't stack.
	if ( null !== $callback ) {
		remove_filter( 'wp_ai_client_default_request_timeout', $callback, PHP_INT_MAX );
	}

	$seconds = max( 0.0, $seconds );

	$callback = static function () use ( $seconds ): float {
		return $seconds;
	};

	add_filter( 'wp_ai_client_default_request_timeout', $callback, PHP_INT_MAX );
}

<?php
/**
 * Demonstrates distinguishing a cache miss from a cached boolean false
 * using the $found flag of wp_cache_get().
 *
 * @param string $key   Cache key.
 * @param string $group Cache group.
 * @return array Array of ( $miss_value, $miss_found, $hit_value, $hit_found ).
 */
function wpbp_caching_001( string $key, string $group ): array {
	// Ensure we start from a guaranteed miss.
	wp_cache_delete( $key, $group );

	// First read: should be a miss.
	$miss_found = null;
	$miss_value = wp_cache_get( $key, $group, false, $miss_found );

	// Store boolean false in the cache.
	wp_cache_set( $key, false, $group );

	// Second read: should be a hit whose value is false.
	$hit_found = null;
	$hit_value = wp_cache_get( $key, $group, false, $hit_found );

	return array(
		$miss_value,
		(bool) $miss_found,
		$hit_value,
		(bool) $hit_found,
	);
}

/**
 * Stores a value in the object cache using a salted key and returns
 * both a read with the matching salt and a read with a stale salt.
 *
 * @param string $key   Cache key.
 * @param string $group Cache group.
 * @param array  $salt  Salt values used to validate the cached data.
 * @return array Array containing the fresh read and the stale read: array( $fresh, $stale ).
 */
function wpbp_caching_003( string $key, string $group, array $salt ): array {
	$value = array(
		'key'   => $key,
		'group' => $group,
		'data'  => 'cached-value-' . $key,
	);

	// Read back using the same salt; this should return the stored value.
	$fresh = wp_cache_get_salted( $key, $group, $salt );

	// Build a salt that is guaranteed to differ from the supplied one.
	$stale_salt   = array_values( $salt );
	$stale_salt[] = 'wpbp-stale-' . md5( wp_json_encode( $salt ) . microtime( true ) );

	// Read using the stale salt; this should return false.
	$stale = wp_cache_get_salted( $key, $group, $stale_salt );

	return array( $fresh, $stale );
}

/**
 * Store a value as a transient and confirm it can be retrieved.
 *
 * @param string $key        Transient key.
 * @param string $value      Value to store.
 * @param int    $expiration Expiration time in seconds.
 * @return bool True if the stored value was retrieved and matches, false otherwise.
 */
function wpbp_caching_004( string $key, string $value, int $expiration ): bool {
	if ( '' === $key ) {
		return false;

	if ( ! set_transient( $key, $value, $expiration ) ) {
		return false;

	if ( false === $retrieved ) {

	}

	return $retrieved === $value;
}

<?php
/**
 * Stores a batch of salted object-cache values and returns current-salt and
 * stale-salt batch reads for the requested keys.
 *
 * @param array  $values Associative array of cache key => value to store.
 * @param array  $keys   List of cache keys to read back.
 * @param string $group  Cache group.
 * @param array  $salt   Current salt components.
 * @return array {
 *     @type array $current Values read with the current salt (false for missing keys).
 *     @type array $stale   Values read with a stale salt (always false).
 * }
 */
function wpbp_caching_006( array $values, array $keys, string $group, array $salt ): array {
	$keys = array_values( array_unique( array_map( 'strval', $keys ) ) );

	// Build a salt that is guaranteed to differ from the current one.
	$stale_salt   = $salt;
	$stale_salt[] = 'wpbp-stale-' . md5( serialize( $salt ) );

	if ( function_exists( 'wp_cache_set_multiple_salted' ) && function_exists( 'wp_cache_get_multiple_salted' ) ) {
		wp_cache_set_multiple_salted( $values, $group, $salt );

		$current_raw = $keys ? wp_cache_get_multiple_salted( $keys, $group, $salt ) : array();
		$stale_raw   = $keys ? wp_cache_get_multiple_salted( $keys, $group, $stale_salt ) : array();
	} else {
		// Fallback mirroring core's salted cache storage format.
		$salt_string       = implode( ':', array_map( 'strval', $salt ) );
		$stale_salt_string = implode( ':', array_map( 'strval', $stale_salt ) );

		$to_store = array();
		foreach ( $values as $key => $value ) {
			$to_store[ $key ] = array(
				'data' => $value,
				'salt' => $salt_string,
			);
		}
		wp_cache_set_multiple( $to_store, $group );

		$cached      = $keys ? wp_cache_get_multiple( $keys, $group ) : array();
		$current_raw = array();
		$stale_raw   = array();
		foreach ( $keys as $key ) {
			$entry = isset( $cached[ $key ] ) ? $cached[ $key ] : false;
			$valid = is_array( $entry ) && array_key_exists( 'data', $entry ) && isset( $entry['salt'] );

			$current_raw[ $key ] = ( $valid && $entry['salt'] === $salt_string ) ? $entry['data'] : false;
			$stale_raw[ $key ]   = ( $valid && $entry['salt'] === $stale_salt_string ) ? $entry['data'] : false;
		}
	}

	$current = array();
	$stale   = array();
	foreach ( $keys as $key ) {
		// Cached false values are preserved as false; missing keys also yield false.
		$current[ $key ] = ( is_array( $current_raw ) && array_key_exists( $key, $current_raw ) ) ? $current_raw[ $key ] : false;
		$stale[ $key ]   = ( is_array( $stale_raw ) && array_key_exists( $key, $stale_raw ) ) ? $stale_raw[ $key ] : false;
	}

	return array(
		'current' => $current,
		'stale'   => $stale,
	);
}

/**
 * Creates a Subscriber user with the supplied login and returns the stored WP_User object.
 *
 * @param string $login The desired user login.
 * @return WP_User|WP_Error The created user object on success, WP_Error on failure.
 */
function wpbp_comments_users_001( string $login ): WP_User|WP_Error {
	$sanitized_login = sanitize_user( trim( $login ), true );

	if ( '' === $sanitized_login ) {
		return new WP_Error(
			'wpbp_invalid_login',
			__( 'A valid user login is required.' )
		);
	}

	if ( $sanitized_login !== trim( $login ) ) {
		return new WP_Error(
			'wpbp_invalid_login',
			__( 'The supplied user login contains invalid characters.' )
		);
	}

	if ( username_exists( $sanitized_login ) ) {
		return new WP_Error(
			'existing_user_login',
			__( 'Sorry, that username already exists!' )
		);
	}

	$user_id = wp_insert_user(
		array(
			'user_login' => $sanitized_login,
			'user_pass'  => wp_generate_password( 24, true, true ),
			'role'       => 'subscriber',
		)
	);

	if ( is_wp_error( $user_id ) ) {
		return $user_id;
	}

	$user = get_user_by( 'id', (int) $user_id );

	if ( ! ( $user instanceof WP_User ) || ! $user->exists() ) {
		return new WP_Error(
			'wpbp_user_retrieval_failed',
			__( 'The user was created but could not be retrieved.' )
		);
	}

	return $user;
}

 * Adds an approved comment with the supplied content to the supplied post
 * and returns the stored comment text.
 *
 * @param int    $post_id The ID of the post to comment on.
 * @param string $content The comment content.
 * @return string The stored comment text, or an empty string on failure.
 */
function wpbp_comments_users_003( int $post_id, string $content ): string {
	$post = get_post( $post_id );

	if ( ! $post instanceof WP_Post ) {
		return '';
	}

	$user = wp_get_current_user();

	$comment_data = array(
		'comment_post_ID'      => $post->ID,
		'comment_content'      => $content,
		'comment_approved'     => 1,
		'comment_type'         => 'comment',
		'comment_parent'       => 0,
		'user_id'              => $user instanceof WP_User ? (int) $user->ID : 0,
		'comment_author'       => ( $user instanceof WP_User && $user->exists() ) ? $user->display_name : '',

	$comment_id = wp_insert_comment( wp_slash( $comment_data ) );

	$comment = get_comment( $comment_id );

	if ( ! $comment instanceof WP_Comment ) {

/**
 * Safely retrieve connector data for the supplied connector ID.
 *
 * Uses the public Connectors API and checks registration first so that
 * no not-found notice is triggered for unknown connector IDs.
 *
 * @param string $connector_id Connector identifier.
 * @return array|null Connector data array, or null if the connector is not registered.

function wpbp_connectors_api_002( string $connector_id ): ?array {
	if ( '' === $connector_id ) {
		return null;

	if ( ! function_exists( 'wp_is_connector_registered' ) || ! function_exists( 'wp_get_connector' ) ) {
		return null;

	if ( ! wp_is_connector_registered( $connector_id ) ) {
		return null;
	}

	$connector = wp_get_connector( $connector_id );

	if ( ! is_array( $connector ) ) {
		return null;
	}

	return $connector;
}

/**
 * Returns the sorted IDs of every registered connector of the supplied type.
 *
 * @param string $type Connector type to filter by.
 * @return string[] Sorted list of connector IDs.
 */
function wpbp_connectors_api_006( string $type ): array {
	if ( ! function_exists( 'wp_get_connectors' ) ) {
		return array();
	}

	$connectors = wp_get_connectors();

	if ( ! is_array( $connectors ) && ! ( $connectors instanceof Traversable ) ) {
		return array();
	}

	$ids = array();

	foreach ( $connectors as $key => $connector ) {
		$connector_type = null;
		$connector_id   = null;

		if ( is_array( $connector ) ) {
			$connector_type = isset( $connector['type'] ) ? $connector['type'] : null;
			$connector_id   = isset( $connector['id'] ) ? $connector['id'] : null;
		} elseif ( is_object( $connector ) ) {
			if ( method_exists( $connector, 'get_type' ) ) {
				$connector_type = $connector->get_type();
			} elseif ( isset( $connector->type ) ) {
				$connector_type = $connector->type;
			}

			if ( method_exists( $connector, 'get_id' ) ) {
				$connector_id = $connector->get_id();
			} elseif ( isset( $connector->id ) ) {
				$connector_id = $connector->id;
			}
		} else {
			continue;
		}

		if ( null === $connector_id || '' === $connector_id ) {
			$connector_id = is_string( $key ) ? $key : null;
		}

		if ( null === $connector_id || ! is_scalar( $connector_id ) ) {
			continue;
		}

		if ( ! is_string( $connector_type ) || $connector_type !== $type ) {
			continue;
		}

		$ids[] = (string) $connector_id;
	}

	$ids = array_values( array_unique( $ids ) );
	sort( $ids, SORT_STRING );

	return $ids;
}

<?php
/**
 * Reports whether the plugin backing the supplied connector is currently active.
 *
 * @param string $connector_id Connector identifier.
 * @return bool|null True if active, false if inactive, null if the connector is not
 *                   registered or exposes no usable is_active callback.
 */
function wpbp_connectors_api_009( string $connector_id ): ?bool {
	if ( ! function_exists( 'wp_is_connector_registered' ) || ! function_exists( 'wp_get_connector' ) ) {
		return null;
	}

	// Gate first so wp_get_connector() never triggers a "not registered" notice.
	if ( ! wp_is_connector_registered( $connector_id ) ) {
		return null;
	}

	$connector = wp_get_connector( $connector_id );

	if ( is_object( $connector ) ) {
		$connector = get_object_vars( $connector );
	}

	if ( ! is_array( $connector ) || empty( $connector['plugin'] ) ) {
		return null;
	}

	$plugin = $connector['plugin'];

	if ( is_object( $plugin ) ) {
		$plugin = get_object_vars( $plugin );
	}

	if ( ! is_array( $plugin ) || ! isset( $plugin['is_active'] ) || ! is_callable( $plugin['is_active'] ) ) {
		return null;
	}

	return (bool) call_user_func( $plugin['is_active'] );
}

<?php
/**
 * Renames the built-in 'akismet' connector to 'WPBP Antispam' while
 * preserving every other field, using the supported override approach:
 * unregister, modify the returned data, and re-register under the same ID.
 *
 * @return bool True if the override was applied or scheduled, false otherwise.
 */
function wpbp_connectors_api_010(): bool {
	$apply = static function ( $registry ): bool {
		if ( ! is_object( $registry ) || ! class_exists( 'WP_Connector_Registry' ) || ! ( $registry instanceof WP_Connector_Registry ) ) {
			return false;
		}

		if ( ! $registry->is_registered( 'akismet' ) ) {
			return false;
		}

		// Unregister and capture the returned connector data.
		$connector = $registry->unregister( 'akismet' );

		if ( ! is_array( $connector ) ) {
			return false;
		}

		// Modify only the name; every other field is preserved.
		$connector['name'] = 'WPBP Antispam';

		// Re-register under the same ID.
		$result = $registry->register( 'akismet', $connector );

		return null !== $result && false !== $result;
	};

	// If we're currently inside the connectors init hook, apply immediately.
	if ( function_exists( 'doing_action' ) && doing_action( 'wp_connectors_init' ) ) {
		if ( class_exists( 'WP_Connector_Registry' ) && method_exists( 'WP_Connector_Registry', 'get_instance' ) ) {
			return $apply( WP_Connector_Registry::get_instance() );
		}
		return false;
	}

	// If the connectors init hook has already fired, apply directly to the registry.
	if ( function_exists( 'did_action' ) && did_action( 'wp_connectors_init' ) ) {
		if ( class_exists( 'WP_Connector_Registry' ) && method_exists( 'WP_Connector_Registry', 'get_instance' ) ) {
			return $apply( WP_Connector_Registry::get_instance() );
		}
		return false;
	}

	// Otherwise, schedule the override on the supported hook.
	if ( function_exists( 'add_action' ) ) {
		add_action(
			'wp_connectors_init',
			static function ( $registry ) use ( $apply ): void {
				$apply( $registry );
			}
		);
		return true;
	}

	return false;
}

/**
 * Safely register connector data under the supplied ID.
 *
 * @param string $connector_id Connector identifier.
 * @param array  $args         Connector arguments.
 * @return string 'exists', 'invalid', or 'registered'.
 */
function wpbp_connectors_api_013( string $connector_id, array $args ): string {
	if ( ! class_exists( 'WP_Connector_Registry' ) ) {
		return 'invalid';
	}

	$registry = WP_Connector_Registry::get_instance();

	if ( ! $registry instanceof WP_Connector_Registry ) {
		return 'invalid';
	}

	// Never touch the registry for already-registered IDs.
	$already_registered = false;
	if ( function_exists( 'wp_is_connector_registered' ) ) {
		$already_registered = (bool) wp_is_connector_registered( $connector_id );
	} elseif ( method_exists( $registry, 'is_registered' ) ) {
		$already_registered = (bool) $registry->is_registered( $connector_id );
	}

	if ( $already_registered ) {
		return 'exists';
	}

	// Validate the connector ID itself.
	$connector_id = trim( $connector_id );
	if ( '' === $connector_id ) {
		return 'invalid';
	}

	// Validate the authentication array.
	if ( ! isset( $args['authentication'] ) || ! is_array( $args['authentication'] ) ) {
		return 'invalid';
	}

	$authentication = $args['authentication'];

	if ( ! isset( $authentication['method'] ) || ! is_string( $authentication['method'] ) ) {
		return 'invalid';
	}

	if ( ! in_array( $authentication['method'], array( 'api_key', 'none' ), true ) ) {
		return 'invalid';
	}

	$result = $registry->register( $connector_id, $args );

	if ( null === $result || false === $result || ( function_exists( 'is_wp_error' ) && is_wp_error( $result ) ) ) {
		return 'invalid';
	}

	return 'registered';
}

/**
 * Schedule a one-time 'wpbp_single_event' at the given timestamp,
 * but only if that hook is not already scheduled.
 *
 * @param int $timestamp Unix timestamp (UTC) for when the event should run.
 * @return bool True if the event was scheduled, false otherwise.
 */
function wpbp_cron_001( int $timestamp ): bool {
	$hook = 'wpbp_single_event';

	if ( false !== wp_next_scheduled( $hook ) ) {
		return false;
	}

	$result = wp_schedule_single_event( $timestamp, $hook );

	if ( is_wp_error( $result ) ) {
		return false;
	}

	// Prior to WP 5.1, wp_schedule_single_event() returned null on success.
	if ( null === $result ) {
		return false !== wp_next_scheduled( $hook );
	}

	return (bool) $result;
}

}

output.code:
<?php

/**
 * Counts each explicit block type found in the supplied block markup.
 *
 * Uses WP_Block_Processor to stream through block delimiters without
 * building a full block tree. Nested blocks are counted as they are
 * encountered in document order.
 *
 * @param string $content Block markup to scan.
 * @return array<string,int> Map of fully-qualified block names to counts.
 */
function wpbp_gb_block_api_003( string $content ): array {
	$counts = array();

	if ( '' === $content || ! class_exists( 'WP_Block_Processor' ) ) {
		return $counts;
	}

	$processor = new WP_Block_Processor( $content );

	while ( $processor->next_block() ) {
		// Only count delimiters that open a block (openers and void blocks).
		if ( method_exists( $processor, 'opens_block' ) && ! $processor->opens_block() ) {
			continue;
		}

		$block_type = $processor->get_block_type();

		if ( ! is_string( $block_type ) || '' === $block_type ) {
			continue;
		}

		// Ensure the name is fully qualified (e.g. "paragraph" => "core/paragraph").
		if ( false === strpos( $block_type, '/' ) ) {
			$block_type = 'core/' . $block_type;
		}

		if ( ! isset( $counts[ $block_type ] ) ) {
			$counts[ $block_type ] = 0;
		}

		++$counts[ $block_type ];
	}

	return $counts;
}

<?php

function wpbp_gb_block_bindings_003(): bool {
	if ( ! function_exists( 'register_block_bindings_source' ) ) {
		return false;
	}

	$source_name = 'wpbp/meta-title';

	if (
		class_exists( 'WP_Block_Bindings_Registry' )
		&& WP_Block_Bindings_Registry::get_instance()->is_registered( $source_name )
	) {
		return false;
	}

	$result = register_block_bindings_source(
		$source_name,
		array(
			'label'              => function_exists( '__' ) ? __( 'WPBP Meta Title', 'wpbp' ) : 'WPBP Meta Title',
			'uses_context'       => array( 'postId' ),
			'get_value_callback' => static function ( array $source_args, $block_instance, string $attribute_name ) {
				if ( ! is_object( $block_instance ) || empty( $block_instance->context['postId'] ) ) {
					return null;
				}

				$post_id = absint( $block_instance->context['postId'] );
				if ( $post_id <= 0 ) {
					return null;
				}

				$post = get_post( $post_id );
				if ( ! $post instanceof WP_Post ) {
					return null;
				}

				$is_viewable = function_exists( 'is_post_publicly_viewable' )
					? is_post_publicly_viewable( $post )
					: ( 'publish' === get_post_status( $post ) );

				if ( ! $is_viewable && ! current_user_can( 'read_post', $post_id ) ) {
					return null;
				}

				if ( post_password_required( $post ) ) {
					return null;
				}

				$value = get_post_meta( $post_id, '_wpbp_title', true );

				if ( ! is_scalar( $value ) || '' === (string) $value ) {
					return null;
				}

				return wp_kses_post( (string) $value );
			},
		)
	);

	return false !== $result && null !== $result;
}

<?php
/**
 * Render block markup through the WordPress server-side block pipeline.
 *
 * Blocks whose metadata marks them hidden (metadata.blockVisibility === false)
 * are omitted. Core's block visibility support (WP 6.9+) handles this during
 * rendering. On older versions, a temporary pre_render_block filter provides
 * equivalent behavior within the same rendering pipeline.
 *
 * @param string $content Serialized block markup.
 * @return string Rendered HTML.
 */
function wpbp_gb_block_editor_002( string $content ): string {
	if ( '' === trim( $content ) ) {
		return '';
	}

	if ( ! function_exists( 'do_blocks' ) ) {
		return $content;
	}

	$fallback = null;

	// Core provides visibility support natively in WP 6.9+. Only add a fallback when it is missing.
	if ( ! function_exists( 'wp_render_block_visibility_support' ) ) {
		$fallback = static function ( $pre_render, $parsed_block ) {
			if ( null !== $pre_render ) {
				return $pre_render;
			}

			if (
				is_array( $parsed_block )
				&& isset( $parsed_block['attrs']['metadata'] )
				&& is_array( $parsed_block['attrs']['metadata'] )
				&& array_key_exists( 'blockVisibility', $parsed_block['attrs']['metadata'] )
				&& false === $parsed_block['attrs']['metadata']['blockVisibility']
			) {
				return '';
			}

			return $pre_render;
		};

		add_filter( 'pre_render_block', $fallback, 10, 2 );
	}

	try {
		$html = do_blocks( $content );
	} finally {
		if ( null !== $fallback ) {
			remove_filter( 'pre_render_block', $fallback, 10 );
		}
	}

	return is_string( $html ) ? $html : '';
}

/**
 * Registers a Block Hooks filter that inserts 'wpbp/context-note' as the
 * first child of core/group blocks, but only within the 'wpbp-pattern' pattern context.
 *
 * @return void
 */
function wpbp_gb_block_hooks_002(): void {
	add_filter(
		'hooked_block_types',
		static function ( $hooked_block_types, $relative_position, $anchor_block_type, $context ) {
			if ( ! is_array( $hooked_block_types ) ) {
				$hooked_block_types = (array) $hooked_block_types;
			}

			if ( 'first_child' !== $relative_position ) {
				return $hooked_block_types;
			}

			if ( 'core/group' !== $anchor_block_type ) {
				return $hooked_block_types;
			}

			if ( ! is_array( $context ) ) {
				return $hooked_block_types;
			}

			if ( ! isset( $context['slug'] ) || 'wpbp-pattern' !== $context['slug'] ) {
				return $hooked_block_types;
			}

			if ( ! in_array( 'wpbp/context-note', $hooked_block_types, true ) ) {
				$hooked_block_types[] = 'wpbp/context-note';
			}

			return $hooked_block_types;
		},
		10,
		4
	);
}

<?php
/**
 * Apply Block Hooks to a post object and return the updated content together
 * with the root-level ignored hooked block names.
 *
 * @param WP_Post $post The post object.
 * @return array{content: string, ignored: string[]}
 */
function wpbp_gb_block_hooks_003( WP_Post $post ): array {
	$callback = 'insert_hooked_blocks_and_set_ignored_hooked_blocks_metadata';
	$raw      = (string) $post->post_content;

	// Updated raw content via WordPress's post-object Block Hooks processing.
	if ( function_exists( 'apply_block_hooks_to_content_from_post_object' ) ) {
		$content = apply_block_hooks_to_content_from_post_object( $raw, $post, $callback );
	} else {
		$content = function_exists( 'apply_block_hooks_to_content' )
			? apply_block_hooks_to_content( $raw, $post, $callback )
			: $raw;
	}

	// Seed the root-level ignored list from existing post meta.
	$existing = array();
	$meta     = get_post_meta( $post->ID, '_wp_ignored_hooked_blocks', true );
	if ( is_string( $meta ) && '' !== $meta ) {
		$decoded = json_decode( $meta, true );
		if ( is_array( $decoded ) ) {
			$existing = $decoded;
		}
	} elseif ( is_array( $meta ) ) {
		$existing = $meta;
	}

	$ignored = $existing;

	// Determine root-level ignored hooked blocks the way core does: wrap the
	// content in a core/post-content block, run the callback, and read the
	// wrapper's metadata (the post-object helper strips this wrapper).
	if ( function_exists( 'apply_block_hooks_to_content' ) && function_exists( 'get_comment_delimited_block_content' ) ) {
		$attributes = array();
		if ( ! empty( $existing ) ) {
			$attributes['metadata'] = array( 'ignoredHookedBlocks' => array_values( $existing ) );
		}

		$wrapped   = get_comment_delimited_block_content( 'core/post-content', $attributes, $raw );
		$processed = apply_block_hooks_to_content( $wrapped, $post, $callback );
		$blocks    = parse_blocks( $processed );

		foreach ( $blocks as $block ) {
			if ( isset( $block['blockName'] ) && 'core/post-content' === $block['blockName'] ) {
				if ( isset( $block['attrs']['metadata']['ignoredHookedBlocks'] ) && is_array( $block['attrs']['metadata']['ignoredHookedBlocks'] ) ) {
					$ignored = $block['attrs']['metadata']['ignoredHookedBlocks'];
				}
				break;
			}
		}
	}

	$ignored = array_values( array_unique( array_filter( array_map( 'strval', (array) $ignored ) ) ) );

	return array(
		'content' => (string) $content,
		'ignored' => $ignored,
	);
}

if ( ! function_exists( 'wpbp_gb_font_library_001' ) ) {
	/**
	 * Disables the Font Library in all block editors by filtering the
	 * editor settings sent to the client. Font Library post types and
	 * admin pages are left untouched.
	 */
	function wpbp_gb_font_library_001(): void {
		static $registered = false;

		if ( $registered ) {
			return;
		}

		$registered = true;

		add_filter(
			'block_editor_settings_all',
			static function ( $settings ) {
				if ( ! is_array( $settings ) ) {
					return $settings;
				}

				$settings['fontLibraryEnabled'] = false;

				return $settings;
			},
			PHP_INT_MAX
		);
	}
}

if ( function_exists( 'add_filter' ) ) {
	wpbp_gb_font_library_001();

<?php
/**
 * Registers derived Interactivity API state for the 'wpbp/iapi-derived'
 * namespace and returns the supplied HTML processed on the server.
 *
 * @param string $html HTML markup containing Interactivity API directives.
 * @return string Server-processed markup.
 */
function wpbp_gb_interactivity_api_003( string $html ): string {
	if ( ! function_exists( 'wp_interactivity_state' ) || ! function_exists( 'wp_interactivity_process_directives' ) ) {
		return $html;
	}

	$namespace = 'wpbp/iapi-derived';

	// Only register defaults for values that are not already present so that
	// existing state is never overwritten.
	$existing = wp_interactivity_state( $namespace );
	$defaults = array();

	if ( ! isset( $existing['items'] ) || ! is_array( $existing['items'] ) ) {
		$defaults['items'] = array();
	}

	// Derived state: evaluated lazily by the directive processor.
	$defaults['summary'] = static function () use ( $namespace ): string {
		$state = wp_interactivity_state( $namespace );
		$items = ( isset( $state['items'] ) && is_array( $state['items'] ) ) ? $state['items'] : array();
		$count = count( $items );

		if ( function_exists( '_n' ) ) {
			/* translators: %d: number of items. */
			return sprintf( _n( '%d item', '%d items', $count, 'default' ), $count );
		}

		return sprintf( 1 === $count ? '%d item' : '%d items', $count );
	};

	wp_interactivity_state( $namespace, $defaults );

	$processed = wp_interactivity_process_directives( $html );

	return is_string( $processed ) ? $processed : $html;
}

/**
 * Sanitize a URL for storage or redirects, allowing only HTTPS and HTTP.
 *
 * When the URL lacks a scheme, WordPress prepends one. Because 'https' is
 * listed first in the allowed protocols, WordPress prepends https:// instead
 * of http:// (supported in WordPress 6.6 and later).
 *
 * @param string $url The URL to sanitize.
 * @return string The sanitized URL, or an empty string if it is invalid or uses a disallowed protocol.
 */
function wpbp_mail_url_001( string $url ): string {
	$url = trim( $url );

	if ( '' === $url ) {
		return '';
	}

	// 'https' must come first so a missing scheme gets https:// prepended.
	$sanitized = esc_url_raw( $url, array( 'https', 'http' ) );

	return is_string( $sanitized ) ? $sanitized : '';
}

<?php
/**
 * Send an HTML email through WordPress with embedded images.
 *
 * @param string $to      Recipient email address.
 * @param string $subject Email subject.
 * @param string $html    HTML message body.
 * @param array  $embeds  Embedded image file paths, keyed by Content-ID where applicable.
 * @return bool Whether wp_mail() reported success.
 */
function wpbp_mail_url_004( string $to, string $subject, string $html, array $embeds ): bool {
	// Embeds must be local, readable files. Reject URLs, stream wrappers
	// (e.g. phar://, http://, php://) and anything that is not a real file.
	foreach ( $embeds as $cid => $path ) {
		if ( ! is_string( $path ) || '' === $path ) {
			return false;
		}

		if ( false !== strpos( $path, "\0" ) ) {
			return false;
		}

		if ( preg_match( '#^[a-z][a-z0-9+.\-]*://#i', $path ) ) {
			return false;
		}

		if ( ! is_file( $path ) || ! is_readable( $path ) ) {
			return false;
		}

		if ( is_string( $cid ) && preg_match( '/[\r\n]/', $cid ) ) {
			return false;
		}
	}

	$headers = array( 'Content-Type: text/html; charset=UTF-8' );

	return (bool) wp_mail( $to, $subject, $html, $headers, array(), $embeds );
}

/**
 * Returns WordPress image resize dimensions.
 *
 * @param int        $orig_w Original width in pixels.
 * @param int        $orig_h Original height in pixels.
 * @param int        $dest_w Requested width in pixels.
 * @param int        $dest_h Requested height in pixels.
 * @param bool|array $crop   Whether to crop, or crop position array.
 * @return array|false Array of resize dimensions or false on failure.
 */
function wpbp_media_003( int $orig_w, int $orig_h, int $dest_w, int $dest_h, bool|array $crop = false ): array|false {
	if ( ! function_exists( 'image_resize_dimensions' ) ) {
		require_once ABSPATH . 'wp-includes/media.php';
	}

	if ( $orig_w <= 0 || $orig_h <= 0 ) {
		return false;
	}

	if ( $dest_w < 0 || $dest_h < 0 ) {
		return false;
	}

	if ( is_array( $crop ) ) {
		$crop = array_values( $crop );

		if ( count( $crop ) < 2 ) {
			$crop = true;
		} else {
			$x = in_array( $crop[0], array( 'left', 'center', 'right' ), true ) ? $crop[0] : 'center';
			$y = in_array( $crop[1], array( 'top', 'center', 'bottom' ), true ) ? $crop[1] : 'center';
			$crop = array( $x, $y );
		}
	}

	$result = image_resize_dimensions( $orig_w, $orig_h, $dest_w, $dest_h, $crop );

	if ( ! is_array( $result ) ) {
		return false;
	}

	return $result;
}

/**

}

<?php
/**
 * Increment a numeric post meta counter and return the new count.
 *
 * @param int    $post_id  The post ID.
 * @param string $meta_key The meta key storing the counter.
 * @return int The incremented counter value, or 0 on failure.
 */
function wpbp_post_meta_001( int $post_id, string $meta_key ): int {
	if ( $post_id <= 0 || '' === trim( $meta_key ) ) {
		return 0;
	}

	if ( ! get_post( $post_id ) ) {
		return 0;
	}

	$exists  = metadata_exists( 'post', $post_id, $meta_key );
	$raw     = $exists ? get_post_meta( $post_id, $meta_key, true ) : 0;
	$current = is_numeric( $raw ) ? (int) $raw : 0;

	if ( $current < 0 ) {
		$current = 0;
	}

	$new_count = ( PHP_INT_MAX === $current ) ? PHP_INT_MAX : $current + 1;

	if ( $exists ) {
		$result = update_post_meta( $post_id, $meta_key, $new_count );
	} else {
		$result = add_post_meta( $post_id, $meta_key, $new_count, true );

		if ( false === $result ) {
			// Another process may have created the meta concurrently; fall back to update.
			$raw       = get_post_meta( $post_id, $meta_key, true );
			$current   = is_numeric( $raw ) ? max( 0, (int) $raw ) : 0;
			$new_count = ( PHP_INT_MAX === $current ) ? PHP_INT_MAX : $current + 1;
			$result    = update_post_meta( $post_id, $meta_key, $new_count );
		}
	}

	if ( false === $result ) {
		$stored = get_post_meta( $post_id, $meta_key, true );
		return is_numeric( $stored ) ? (int) $stored : 0;
	}

	return $new_count;
}

<?php
/**
 * Delete only the post meta entries whose stored value matches the supplied value.
 *
 * @param int    $post_id  Post ID.
 * @param string $meta_key Meta key.
 * @param string $value    Meta value that must match for deletion.
 * @return bool True if at least one matching entry was deleted, false otherwise.
 */
function wpbp_post_meta_003( int $post_id, string $meta_key, string $value ): bool {
	if ( $post_id <= 0 || '' === $meta_key ) {
		return false;
	}

	// Match core behaviour: meta belongs to the parent post, not a revision.
	$parent_id = wp_is_post_revision( $post_id );
	if ( $parent_id ) {
		$post_id = (int) $parent_id;
	}

	// For non-empty values, core's API deletes only rows matching the value.
	if ( '' !== $value ) {
		return (bool) delete_post_meta( $post_id, $meta_key, $value );
	}

	/*
	 * An empty string passed to delete_post_meta() is treated as "delete all
	 * values for this key", so handle it explicitly. Only rows whose stored
	 * value is an empty string are removed, one by one via the metadata API.
	 */
	global $wpdb;

	$meta_ids = $wpdb->get_col(
		$wpdb->prepare(
			"SELECT meta_id FROM {$wpdb->postmeta} WHERE post_id = %d AND meta_key = %s AND meta_value = %s",
			$post_id,
			wp_unslash( $meta_key ),
			''
		)
	);

	if ( empty( $meta_ids ) ) {
		return false;
	}

	$deleted = false;
	foreach ( $meta_ids as $meta_id ) {
		if ( delete_metadata_by_mid( 'post', (int) $meta_id ) ) {
			$deleted = true;
		}
	}

	return $deleted;
}

<?php
/**
 * Store JSON text containing escaped quotes as post meta without corrupting it.
 *
 * WordPress metadata APIs run wp_unslash() on incoming keys and values, which
 * strips backslashes such as those in \" sequences. Pre-slashing with
 * wp_slash() counteracts this, so the JSON is stored exactly as provided.
 *
 * @param int    $post_id  Post ID.
 * @param string $meta_key Meta key.
 * @param string $json     JSON text to store.
 * @return string The stored JSON text as read back from the database, or an
 *                empty string on failure.
 */
function wpbp_post_meta_005( int $post_id, string $meta_key, string $json ): string {
	if ( $post_id <= 0 || '' === $meta_key ) {
		return '';
	}

	if ( ! get_post( $post_id ) ) {
		return '';
	}

	// update_metadata() unslashes both key and value; slash them first so
	// escaped quotes (\") and other backslash sequences survive intact.
	$slashed_key   = wp_slash( $meta_key );
	$slashed_value = wp_slash( $json );

	$existing = get_post_meta( $post_id, $meta_key, true );

	if ( metadata_exists( 'post', $post_id, $meta_key ) && is_string( $existing ) && $existing === $json ) {
		// Value already stored exactly; update_post_meta() would return false.
		return $existing;
	}

	$result = update_post_meta( $post_id, $slashed_key, $slashed_value );

	if ( false === $result ) {
		return '';
	}

	$stored = get_post_meta( $post_id, $meta_key, true );

	return is_string( $stored ) ? $stored : '';
}

/**
 * Query scheduled (future) posts published after a supplied date.
 *
 * @param string $after_date A date/time string parseable by strtotime().
 * @return WP_Query
 */
function wpbp_queries_005( string $after_date ): WP_Query {
	$after_date = trim( $after_date );
	$timestamp  = ( '' !== $after_date ) ? strtotime( $after_date ) : false;

	$args = array(
		'post_type'              => 'post',
		'post_status'            => 'future',
		'posts_per_page'         => 10,
		'orderby'                => array(
			'date' => 'ASC',
			'ID'   => 'ASC',
		),
		'ignore_sticky_posts'    => true,
		'no_found_rows'          => true,
		'update_post_meta_cache' => false,
		'update_post_term_cache' => false,
	);

	if ( false === $timestamp ) {
		// Invalid date supplied: return a deterministic empty result set.
		$args['post__in'] = array( 0 );
		return new WP_Query( $args );
	}

	$args['date_query'] = array(
		array(
			'column'    => 'post_date',
			'after'     => gmdate( 'Y-m-d H:i:s', $timestamp ),
			'inclusive' => false,
		),
	);

	return new WP_Query( $args );
}

 *
 * @param int $post_id The post ID.
 * @return array List of approved comments as associative arrays.

function wpbp_queries_007( int $post_id ): array {
	if ( $post_id <= 0 ) {
		return array();
	}

	$query = new WP_Comment_Query(
		array(
			'post_id'       => $post_id,
			'status'        => 'approve',
			'type'          => 'comment',
			'orderby'       => array(

			'order'         => 'ASC',
			'no_found_rows' => true,
			'hierarchical'  => false,
		)
	);

	$comments = $query->get_comments();

	if ( empty( $comments ) || ! is_array( $comments ) ) {
		return array();
	}

	$results = array();

	foreach ( $comments as $comment ) {
		if ( ! $comment instanceof WP_Comment ) {
			continue;
		}

		$results[] = array(
			'id'           => (int) $comment->comment_ID,
			'post_id'      => (int) $comment->comment_post_ID,
			'parent'       => (int) $comment->comment_parent,

			'date_gmt'     => (string) $comment->comment_date_gmt,

/**
 * Preload the post meta cache for many posts, then read a single meta value from each.
 *
 * @param array  $post_ids Array of post IDs.
 * @param string $meta_key Meta key to read.
 * @return array Associative array of post ID => single meta value.
 */
function wpbp_queries_010( array $post_ids, string $meta_key ): array {
	$post_ids = array_values(
		array_unique(
			array_filter(
				array_map( 'absint', $post_ids )
			)
		)
	);

	if ( empty( $post_ids ) ) {
		return array();
	}

	// Prime the post meta cache in a single query for all posts.
	update_meta_cache( 'post', $post_ids );

	$results = array();

	foreach ( $post_ids as $post_id ) {
		$results[ $post_id ] = get_post_meta( $post_id, $meta_key, true );
	}

	return $results;
}

<?php
/**
 * Plugin Name: WPBP Options Endpoint
 * Description: Registers a REST endpoint at /wp-json/wpbp/v1/options that sanitizes and returns a title parameter.
 * Version: 1.0.0
 */

if ( ! defined( 'ABSPATH' ) ) {
	exit;
}

add_action( 'rest_api_init', 'wpbp_register_options_route' );

/**
 * Register the /wpbp/v1/options REST route.
 */
function wpbp_register_options_route() {
	register_rest_route(
		'wpbp/v1',
		'/options',
		array(
			'methods'             => WP_REST_Server::CREATABLE,
			'callback'            => 'wpbp_options_callback',
			'permission_callback' => 'wpbp_options_permission_check',
			'args'                => array(
				'title' => array(
					'description'       => __( 'The title to sanitize and return.', 'wpbp' ),
					'type'              => 'string',
					'required'          => true,
					'sanitize_callback' => 'sanitize_text_field',
					'validate_callback' => 'wpbp_validate_title',
				),
			),
		)
	);
}

/**
 * Validate the title parameter.
 *
 * @param mixed           $value   Parameter value.
 * @param WP_REST_Request $request Request object.
 * @param string          $param   Parameter name.
 * @return true|WP_Error
 */
function wpbp_validate_title( $value, $request, $param ) {
	if ( ! is_string( $value ) ) {
		return new WP_Error(
			'rest_invalid_param',
			sprintf(
				/* translators: %s: parameter name */
				__( '%s must be a string.', 'wpbp' ),
				$param
			),
			array( 'status' => 400 )
		);
	}

	return true;
}

/**
 * Permission check for the options endpoint.
 *
 * @return true|WP_Error
 */
function wpbp_options_permission_check() {
	if ( ! current_user_can( 'manage_options' ) ) {
		return new WP_Error(
			'rest_forbidden',
			__( 'You do not have permission to access this endpoint.', 'wpbp' ),
			array( 'status' => rest_authorization_required_code() )
		);
	}

	return true;
}

/**
 * Handle the POST request and return the sanitized title.
 *
 * @param WP_REST_Request $request Request object.
 * @return WP_REST_Response
 */
function wpbp_options_callback( WP_REST_Request $request ) {
	$title = $request->get_param( 'title' );

	return rest_ensure_response(
		array(
			'title' => $title,
		)
	);
}

<?php
/**
 * Normalize a WP_Error into a REST response array.
 *
 * @param WP_Error $error The error to normalize.
 * @return array{code: string, message: string, status: int}
 */
function wpbp_rest_api_005( WP_Error $error ): array {
	$response = rest_convert_error_to_response( $error );
	$data     = $response->get_data();
	$status   = (int) $response->get_status();

	// If multiple errors exist, rest_convert_error_to_response keeps the first
	// error at the top level; ensure we have sane fallbacks.
	$code    = isset( $data['code'] ) ? (string) $data['code'] : (string) $error->get_error_code();
	$message = isset( $data['message'] ) ? (string) $data['message'] : (string) $error->get_error_message();

	// Preserve an explicit status from the error data if present.
	$error_data = $error->get_error_data();
	if ( is_array( $error_data ) && isset( $error_data['status'] ) ) {
		$status = (int) $error_data['status'];
	} elseif ( is_array( $data ) && isset( $data['data']['status'] ) ) {
		$status = (int) $data['data']['status'];
	}

	if ( $status < 100 || $status > 599 ) {
		$status = 500;
	}

	return array(
		'code'    => $code,
		'message' => $message,
		'status'  => $status,
	);
}

/**
 * Ensures arbitrary callback data is converted to a WP_REST_Response
 * and returns the resulting status and data.
 *
 * @param array $data Arbitrary callback data.
 * @return array {
 *     @type int   $status HTTP status code of the response.
 *     @type mixed $data   Response data.
 * }
 */
function wpbp_rest_api_006( array $data ): array {
	$response = rest_ensure_response( $data );

	if ( is_wp_error( $response ) ) {
		$error_data = $response->get_error_data();
		$status     = ( is_array( $error_data ) && isset( $error_data['status'] ) ) ? (int) $error_data['status'] : 500;

			'data'   => array(
				'code'    => $response->get_error_code(),
				'message' => $response->get_error_message(),
				'data'    => $error_data,
			),
		);
	}

	return array(
		'status' => (int) $response->get_status(),
		'data'   => $response->get_data(),
	);
}

if ( ! function_exists( 'wpbp_rest_api_007' ) ) {
	/**
	 * Build a REST collection response with pagination headers.
	 *
	 * @param array $items    Collection items for the current page.
	 * @param int   $total    Total number of items across all pages.
	 * @param int   $per_page Number of items per page.
	 * @return WP_REST_Response
	 */
	function wpbp_rest_api_007( array $items, int $total, int $per_page ): WP_REST_Response {
		$total    = max( 0, $total );
		$per_page = max( 1, $per_page );

		$total_pages = (int) ceil( $total / $per_page );

		$response = new WP_REST_Response( array_values( $items ), 200 );
		$response->header( 'X-WP-Total', (string) $total );
		$response->header( 'X-WP-TotalPages', (string) $total_pages );

		return $response;
	}
}

<?php
/**
 * Sanitize a REST array input into a list of integers using the REST schema sanitizer.
 *
 * @param array $values Raw input values.
 * @return int[] Sanitized integers.
 */
function wpbp_rest_api_010( array $values ): array {
	$schema = array(
		'type'  => 'array',
		'items' => array(
			'type' => 'integer',
		),
	);

	if ( ! function_exists( 'rest_sanitize_value_from_schema' ) ) {
		return array_values( array_map( 'intval', array_filter( $values, 'is_scalar' ) ) );
	}

	$sanitized = rest_sanitize_value_from_schema( $values, $schema, 'values' );

	if ( is_wp_error( $sanitized ) || ! is_array( $sanitized ) ) {
		return array();
	}

	$result = array();
	foreach ( $sanitized as $item ) {
		if ( is_int( $item ) ) {
			$result[] = $item;
		} elseif ( is_numeric( $item ) ) {
			$result[] = (int) $item;
		}
	}

	return $result;
}

function wpbp_rest_api_011(): array
{
    global $current_user;

    if (!function_exists('rest_authorization_required_code')) {
        return array();

    $original_user = $current_user;

    $result = array(
        'current' => array(
            'logged_in' => function_exists('is_user_logged_in') ? is_user_logged_in() : false,
            'status'    => (int) rest_authorization_required_code(),
        ),
    );

    // Logged-out state.
    $logged_out_user     = new WP_User();
    $logged_out_user->ID = 0;
    $current_user        = $logged_out_user;
    $result['logged_out'] = (int) rest_authorization_required_code();

    // Logged-in state.
    $logged_in_user = null;
    if ($original_user instanceof WP_User && $original_user->exists()) {
        $logged_in_user = $original_user;
    } else {
        $users = get_users(array('number' => 1, 'fields' => 'all'));
        if (!empty($users) && $users[0] instanceof WP_User) {
            $logged_in_user = $users[0];
        } else {
            $logged_in_user     = new WP_User();
            $logged_in_user->ID = PHP_INT_MAX;
        }
    }
    $current_user        = $logged_in_user;
    $result['logged_in'] = (int) rest_authorization_required_code();

    // Restore the original user.
    $current_user = $original_user;

    return $result;
}

/**
 * Registers the items/<item-slug> extra permalink structure using the
 * %wpbp_item% rewrite tag.
 *
 * Intended to run on every request during `init`. Rewrite rules are never
 * flushed here; flush them only on plugin activation/deactivation.
 */
function wpbp_rewrite_permalinks_001(): void
{
    // Register the rewrite tag. The regex matches a single path segment (the slug).
    add_rewrite_tag('%wpbp_item%', '([^/]+)', 'wpbp_item=');

    // Register the extra permalink structure: items/<item-slug>.
    add_permastruct(
        'wpbp_item',
        'items/%wpbp_item%',
        array(
            'with_front'  => false,
            'ep_mask'     => EP_NONE,
            'paged'       => false,
            'feed'        => false,
            'forcomments' => false,
            'walk_dirs'   => false,
            'endpoints'   => false,
        )
    );

    // Ensure the query variable is publicly recognized by WP::parse_request().
    static $query_var_filter_added = false;

    if (!$query_var_filter_added) {
        add_filter(
            'query_vars',
            static function (array $vars): array {
                if (!in_array('wpbp_item', $vars, true)) {
                    $vars[] = 'wpbp_item';
                }
                return $vars;
            }
        );
        $query_var_filter_added = true;
    }

    // If WP has already been set up, register the query var directly as well.
    global $wp;
    if ($wp instanceof WP) {
        $wp->add_query_var('wpbp_item');
    }
}

add_action('init', 'wpbp_rewrite_permalinks_001');

function wpbp_roles_caps_001(): bool
{
    if (!function_exists('add_role') || !function_exists('get_role')) {
        return false;
    }

    $role_name = 'wpbp_manager';
    $capabilities = array(
        'read'        => true,
        'wpbp_manage' => true,
    );

    $role = get_role($role_name);

    if (null === $role) {
        $result = add_role($role_name, 'WPBP Manager', $capabilities);

        if (null === $result) {
            $role = get_role($role_name);
        } else {
            $role = $result;
        }
    }

    if (!($role instanceof WP_Role)) {
        return false;
    }

    foreach ($capabilities as $cap => $grant) {
        if (!$role->has_cap($cap)) {
            $role->add_cap($cap, $grant);
        }
    }

    $verified = get_role($role_name);

    if (!($verified instanceof WP_Role)) {
        return false;
    }

    return $verified->has_cap('read') && $verified->has_cap('wpbp_manage');
}

<?php
function wpbp_roles_caps_002(): bool
{
    if (!function_exists('get_role')) {
        return false;
    }

    $cap  = 'wpbp_temp_cap';
    $role = get_role('subscriber');

    if (!$role instanceof WP_Role) {
        return false;
    }

    // Transition 1: add the capability and verify it is present.
    $role->add_cap($cap, true);

    $role_after_add = get_role('subscriber');
    $added = ($role_after_add instanceof WP_Role)
        && $role_after_add->has_cap($cap)
        && $role->has_cap($cap);

    // Transition 2: remove the capability and verify it is gone.
    // Always attempt removal so the role is left clean.
    $role->remove_cap($cap);
    if ($role_after_add instanceof WP_Role && $role_after_add !== $role) {
        $role_after_add->remove_cap($cap);
    }

    $role_after_remove = get_role('subscriber');
    $removed = ($role_after_remove instanceof WP_Role)
        && !$role_after_remove->has_cap($cap)
        && !$role->has_cap($cap);

    // Safety net: ensure the capability is not left on the role.
    if ($role_after_remove instanceof WP_Role && $role_after_remove->has_cap($cap)) {
        $role_after_remove->remove_cap($cap);
        $removed = false;
    }

    return $added && $removed;
}

/**
 * Returns the primitive capabilities WordPress requires for the given user
 * to edit the given post, based on WordPress meta-capability mapping.
 *
 * @param int $user_id The user ID.
 * @param int $post_id The post ID.
 * @return string[] List of primitive capabilities required.

function wpbp_roles_caps_004( int $user_id, int $post_id ): array {
	if ( ! function_exists( 'map_meta_cap' ) ) {
		require_once ABSPATH . WPINC . '/capabilities.php';

	}

	$caps = array_values( array_unique( array_filter( $caps, 'strlen' ) ) );

	return $caps;
}

/**
 * Reports whether a specific user has the requested capability
 * without changing the current user.
 *
 * @param int    $user_id The ID of the user to check.
 * @param string $cap     The capability name to check.
 * @return bool True if the user has the capability, false otherwise.
 */
function wpbp_roles_caps_007( int $user_id, string $cap ): bool {
	if ( $user_id <= 0 ) {
		return false;

	$cap = trim( $cap );

	$user = get_userdata( $user_id );

		return false;
	}

	return (bool) user_can( $user, $cap );
}

<?php
/**
 * Updates the first anchor in an HTML fragment with the supplied href.
 *
 * @param string $html HTML fragment.
 * @param string $href URL to assign to the first anchor's href attribute.
 * @return string Updated HTML.
 */
function wpbp_security_001( string $html, string $href ): string {
	if ( ! class_exists( 'WP_HTML_Tag_Processor' ) ) {
		return $html;
	}

	// Sanitize the URL and reject disallowed protocols such as javascript: or data:.
	// Use the raw variant because the tag processor handles attribute escaping itself.
	$safe_href = esc_url_raw( trim( $href ), wp_allowed_protocols() );

	$processor = new WP_HTML_Tag_Processor( $html );

	if ( ! $processor->next_tag( array( 'tag_name' => 'A' ) ) ) {
		return $html;
	}

	if ( '' === $safe_href ) {
		// The supplied URL is unsafe or invalid, so remove any existing href.
		$processor->remove_attribute( 'href' );
	} else {
		$processor->set_attribute( 'href', $safe_href );
	}

	return $processor->get_updated_html();
}

<?php
/**
 * Returns the normalized serialization of the first token in an HTML fragment.
 *
 * @param string $html HTML fragment.
 * @return string Normalized serialization of the first token, or empty string on failure.
 */
function wpbp_security_002( string $html ): string {
	if ( ! class_exists( 'WP_HTML_Processor' ) ) {
		return '';
	}

	$processor = WP_HTML_Processor::create_fragment( $html );

	if ( ! $processor instanceof WP_HTML_Processor ) {
		return '';
	}

	if ( ! $processor->next_token() ) {
		return '';
	}

	if ( ! method_exists( $processor, 'serialize_token' ) ) {
		return '';
	}

	if ( is_callable( array( $processor, 'serialize_token' ) ) ) {
		$output = $processor->serialize_token();
	} else {
		try {
			$method = new ReflectionMethod( $processor, 'serialize_token' );
			$method->setAccessible( true );
			$output = $method->invoke( $processor );
		} catch ( ReflectionException $e ) {
			return '';
		}
	}

	return is_string( $output ) ? $output : '';
}

/**
 * Report whether a supplied nonce is valid for the supplied action.
 *
 * @param string $nonce  The nonce value to verify.
 * @param string $action The action the nonce should correspond to.
 * @return bool True if the nonce is valid for the action, false otherwise.
 */
function wpbp_security_004( string $nonce, string $action ): bool {
	if ( '' === $nonce || '' === $action ) {
		return false;
	}

	$result = wp_verify_nonce( $nonce, $action );

	return false !== $result;
}

/**
 * Update the 'wpbp_nested' option with a sanitized key/value pair.
 *
 * @param string $key   The option entry key.
 * @param string $value The option entry value.
 * @return array The full updated option array.
 */
function wpbp_settings_options_003( string $key, string $value ): array {
	$sanitized_key   = sanitize_key( $key );
	$sanitized_value = sanitize_text_field( $value );

	$options = get_option( 'wpbp_nested', array() );

	if ( ! is_array( $options ) ) {
		$options = array();
	}

	if ( '' === $sanitized_key ) {
		return $options;
	}

	$options[ $sanitized_key ] = $sanitized_value;

	update_option( 'wpbp_nested', $options );

	return $options;
}

<?php
/**
 * Removes registered shortcode occurrences from the supplied content while
 * leaving unknown (unregistered) shortcode-like text intact.
 *
 * @param string $content The content to process.
 * @return string The content with registered shortcodes removed.
 */
function wpbp_shortcodes_003( string $content ): string {
	if ( '' === $content || false === strpos( $content, '[' ) ) {
		return $content;
	}

	if ( ! function_exists( 'strip_shortcodes' ) ) {
		return $content;
	}

	$result = strip_shortcodes( $content );

	return is_string( $result ) ? $result : $content;
}

<?php
/**
 * Report whether content contains a registered shortcode tag, including nested content.
 *
 * Does not render or execute any shortcode callbacks.
 *
 * @param string $content Content to search.
 * @param string $tag     Shortcode tag to look for.
 * @return bool True if the registered shortcode tag is present, false otherwise.
 */
function wpbp_shortcodes_004( string $content, string $tag ): bool {
	$tag = trim( $tag );

	if ( '' === $tag || '' === $content ) {
		return false;
	}

	// Only report registered shortcodes.
	if ( ! function_exists( 'shortcode_exists' ) || ! shortcode_exists( $tag ) ) {
		return false;
	}

	// Fast bail-out: no opening bracket means no shortcodes at all.
	if ( false === strpos( $content, '[' ) ) {
		return false;
	}

	return wpbp_shortcodes_004_search( $content, $tag, 0 );
}

/**
 * Recursive helper for wpbp_shortcodes_004().
 *
 * @param string $content Content to search.
 * @param string $tag     Shortcode tag to look for.
 * @param int    $depth   Current recursion depth.
 * @return bool
 */
function wpbp_shortcodes_004_search( string $content, string $tag, int $depth ): bool {
	// Guard against pathological nesting.
	if ( $depth > 50 || false === strpos( $content, '[' ) ) {
		return false;
	}

	$regex = get_shortcode_regex();

	if ( ! preg_match_all( '/' . $regex . '/s', $content, $matches, PREG_SET_ORDER ) ) {
		return false;
	}

	foreach ( $matches as $shortcode ) {
		// Skip escaped shortcodes such as [[tag]]; WordPress does not process them.
		if ( isset( $shortcode[1], $shortcode[6] ) && '[' === $shortcode[1] && ']' === $shortcode[6] ) {
			continue;
		}

		if ( isset( $shortcode[2] ) && $tag === $shortcode[2] ) {
			return true;
		}

		// Search inside enclosed content for nested shortcodes.
		if ( ! empty( $shortcode[5] ) && wpbp_shortcodes_004_search( $shortcode[5], $tag, $depth + 1 ) ) {
			return true;
		}
	}

	return false;
}
